summary: the fused target book is scaled by its measured portfolio diversification: a cross-section that is really one bet can no longer carry a full per-name budget on every name — PDM = min(1, sigma_indep/sigma_actual) over the EWMA daily-return covariance that already prices VaR and the hedge advisor, so uncorrelated names are untouched, N perfectly correlated names collapse to one budget of risk, an internally-hedged book is never levered up, and an uncovered name is neither summed nor scaled (ADR-0079)
